verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a skills/plugin framework that installs into agent harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, Devin CLI and Hermes, rather than being an agent itself. Shipping an official MCP server is therefore a plausible capability, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an MCP server or endpoint. The documented integration paths (harness plugin installs, session-start bootstrap injection, copying skill folders) are a different mechanism and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
